steps.label: S1
steps.title: Step 1- Defining the scope of the BCI Schedule of Delivery Ontology through literature review
steps.input: 概念文献语料（top-down scoping review 的对象）
steps.output: 本体范围定义与初始类清单（文献回顾产出）

steps.label: S2
steps.title: Step 2- Identifying key BCI Schedule of Delivery classes and their definitions
steps.input: Step 1 抽取的信息（范围与初始清单）
steps.output: 关键类及其定义的初始结构

steps.label: S3
steps.title: Step 3- Refinement of the BCI Schedule of Delivery Ontology through an iterative process of literature annotation, discussion and revision
steps.output: 经文献标注—讨论—修订迭代精炼后的本体版本

steps.label: S4
steps.title: Step 4 – Expert stakeholder review
steps.output: 专家利益相关者评审意见与相应修订

steps.label: S5
steps.title: Step 5 – Inter-rater reliability of annotations using the BCI Schedule of Delivery Ontology
steps.input: Step 4 评审后的本体与标注指南
steps.output: 标注者间信度（Krippendorff's α）评估结果

steps.label: S6
steps.title: Step 6 - Specifying relationships between classes
steps.output: 类间关系规格（与 BFO 对齐的关系定义）

steps.label: S7
steps.title: Step 7 – Making the Schedule of Delivery Ontology machine-readable and available online
steps.output: 机器可读并在线发布的本体（OWL 发布件）
